Reliance Industries Ltd

About

Reliance Industries Limited is a Fortune 500 company and is the largest private sector corporation in India. The company operates in hydrocarbon exploration, petroleum refining, petrochemicals, retail and digital services.[1]

Key Points

Business Segments
Oil to chemicals, retail, digital services and new energy make up most of the company's revenue.
